finding.claim: ADR-0007 decision 4 (stateless server, identity never read from the connection) contradicts the v1 fix for #542 and #539, which read clientInfo off the live connection at tool-call time for 2025-xx clients.

archaeology.INTRODUCED_BY_1: 7e67952c 2026-05-12 'fix(detect): thread MCP clientInfo through ctx_upgrade to upgrade() (closes #542 partial 3/6)'
archaeology.ORIGINAL_INTENT_1: Commit message: 'Captures the live MCP clientInfo via server.server.getClientVersion() (in-process - no spawn boundary loses the handshake info)' then resolves PlatformId via detectPlatform(clientInfo).
archaeology.INTRODUCED_BY_2: 8b9d13a1 2026-05-12 'test(detect): pin MCP clientInfo priority over env-var detection (closes #539 partial 4/5)'
archaeology.ORIGINAL_INTENT_2: Commit message: 'when the MCP initialize handshake supplies clientInfo.name, the client-map lookup wins over any env-var permutation', guarding detect.ts:135 priority ordering.
archaeology.REGRESSION_RISK: getClientVersion() returns the SDK's per-connection cache populated at the initialize handshake. For 2025-xx clients (2025-03-26 .. 2025-11-25), clientInfo is only ever sent at initialize and only exists tied to that connection - there is no per-request _meta carrying it (ADR-0007 itself: _meta clientInfo is new in 2026-07-28). So ADR-0007 decision 4 ('client info ... never from the connection') as literally written forbids the exact mechanism #542/#539 depend on for every 2025-xx client, which per ADR-0007's own live probe (Claude Code 2.1.283 on 2025-11-25, Codex CLI on 2025-06-18) is 100% of agents tested today. If v2 implements decision 4 literally, ctx_upgrade/ctx_doctor platform detection for 2025-xx clients regresses to the pre-fix heuristic/env-var chain that #542 and #539 were filed against.
archaeology.SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: Scope decision 4 to session/user identity (the thing ADR-0002/single context.db cares about), not to the SDK's initialize-time clientInfo cache. Explicitly allow reading getClientVersion()-equivalent per-connection clientInfo for platform/client detection in ctx_doctor/ctx_upgrade on 2025-xx connections. Add a GP1/GP2 case: run ctx_upgrade under a 2025-xx handshake with Claude-Code-like clientInfo and VSCODE_PID polluting env, assert the client-map lookup still wins (regression guard for #539) and platform resolves correctly (regression guard for #542).

finding.fix: Scope ADR-0007 decision 4 to session/user identity only; explicitly carve out SDK initialize-time clientInfo reads for 2025-xx client/platform detection; add the GP1/GP2 regression case above.

notes: Verified both commits exist in cm-main with the exact quoted commit messages and diffs (src/server.ts, src/cli.ts, tests/util/ctx-upgrade-platform-threading.test.ts for 7e67952c; tests/adapters/detect-claude-code-in-vscode.test.ts for 8b9d13a1). ADR-0007 text confirms decision 4 says 'never from the connection' and confirms _meta-carried clientInfo is new only in 2026-07-28, so the contradiction for 2025-xx clients is real as literally written. Not addressed by DECISIONS-r3.md (only Q11 on project source fallback is appended to this ADR). Downgrading from 'contradiction' claim: this is a scoping gap in decision 4's wording, not an irreconcilable conflict - the fix is a one-sentence scope clarification plus a test, but as written today the doc does contradict the v1 fix behaviour, so the finding stands.
